entries.title: First release: the rebuilt Cylex emote menu, successor of Animation Menu v2

changes.text: A new emote menu built from scratch: over 6,000 emotes with animated previews that load smoothly as you scroll, search, favourites, recently used and categories
Drop-in replacement for Animation Menu v2 and rpemotes: your existing animation lists, custom emotes and other scripts' exports and events keep working
Quick slots: drag an emote onto a slot and play it with one key (Alt, Shift or Ctrl + 1-8, chosen by the player or forced by the server)
Shared emotes with a right click: invite the closest player directly or pick from a nearby list, checked by the server
Player settings: accent colour with a custom colour picker, click to play, sounds, cancel on move, playback speed, remember the last tab
Sit anywhere, walk and expression styles that stay after reconnecting or changing clothes
Built-in notifications and text prompts, or switch to your own notify script from one config file
Emotes no longer break when you open a door or bump into someone, and props are cleaned up when you cancel
Server owners can lock categories by permission, change the menu logo and edit everything from the editable folder
